analyst_view.overall: Hamburg (12th) host Bayern (2nd) a week after a 4-0 Nordderby defeat at Werder Bremen; Muheim (muscle tear) and Poulsen are probably out for the rest of the year, and Lokonga, Nadir and Remberg are also out, while Vuskovic may make his first appearance. Bayern lost 2-1 at Lille on Wednesday, their first defeat of the season, with an improvised attack (Laimer up front): Harry Kane is out for months, Michael Olise has only just started running, and Neuer, Gnabry, Saibari and Davies are out too, while Musiala and Luis Díaz are back from injury but only came off the bench. The numbers count Kane, Saibari, Gnabry and Davies on Bayern's goals but not Olise, so I take a little off goals for him, and I keep my trims on shots and shots on target, where none of the absences are counted. Referee Bastian Dankert (3.2 cards a game) is now in the numbers.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.1 goals, 2.2 of them Bayern's, and take Kane (about -15%), Saibari, Gnabry and Davies off Bayern, plus Poulsen and Lokonga off Hamburg. Olise, Bayern's other main creator and scorer, is no longer on their missing list although he has only just started running, and Bayern looked blunt at Lille three days earlier, so I take 7% off, to about 2.9; Hamburg losing Muheim and Musiala's return limit the cut.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.7 corners. Bayern will still have most of the ball and pin Hamburg back, and fewer wide attackers (Olise, Gnabry, Davies out) could mean a little less crossing, but Hamburg without left wing-back Muheim may concede more down the flanks, so I stay at 9.7.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.2 cards; they already take about 19% off for referee Bastian Dankert (3.2 a game) and some for Bayern's calm recent record, and add a little for past meetings. Hamburg will want a reaction after the derby defeat, but nothing points clearly up or down beyond what the numbers count, so I stay at 3.2.

shots.text: The numbers say 32.3 shots and already add 14% for Bayern's high recent shot count, which came with Kane and Olise in the side; their absences are counted on goals, not on shots. Bayern should still dominate but create less, as at Lille with Laimer as a makeshift striker, and they play two and a half days after that away game, so I take 6% off, to about 30.4.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.8 shots on target, 7.1 of them Bayern's, without taking off Kane and Olise, their most accurate shooters (injuries are counted only on goals). Musiala and Díaz are back but short of match time, so I keep an 8% cut, to about 9.9.
